answer: The fee is charged through an echo debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the lantern totals, and the karst anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 24 units per epoch, sustaining 54 aliases for 59 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
